description: This Java source file defines the class 'DittoProtocolAdapter' which acts as an adapter for the Ditto protocol. It handles conversions between different message types, commands, events, and responses, effectively enabling communication with the Ditto protocol by translating various signals to and from protocol-specific representations.

classes.name: DittoProtocolAdapter
classes.description: The main adapter class that facilitates translation between generic signals, commands, events, and the Ditto protocol-specific representations. It manages various adapter providers and handles the conversion logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new DittoProtocolAdapter instance with a given HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a default new instance of DittoProtocolAdapter with default configurations.

methods.name: getHeaderTranslator
methods.description: Creates and returns the default HeaderTranslator for this protocol.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object into a Signal<?> based on the appropriate adapter.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Overloaded methods to convert signals, commands, events, or responses into Adaptable objects suitable for communication over the Ditto protocol.

methods.name: headerTranslator
methods.description: Accessor for the HeaderTranslator used by this adapter.

methods.name: validateChannel
methods.description: Validates if the given channel is supported for the provided signal or command.

methods.name: validateNotLive
methods.description: Ensures that certain commands or responses are not sent over the LIVE channel.

methods.name: unknownChannelException
methods.description: Creates an exception for unsupported channel-signal combinations.
